newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALY NAME SQUAD FOR ENGLAND MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALY NAME SQUAD FOR ENGLAND MATCH.

text.p: Italy soccer coach Cesare Maldini named his 21-man squad on Tuesday for a World Cup group two qualifying match against England at Wembley on February 12.
Defenders - Ciro Ferrara, Alessandro Costacurta, Alessandro Nesta, Fabio Cannavaro, Paolo Maldini, Salvatore Fresi, Antonio Benarrivo, Christian Panucci.
Midfielders - Angelo Di Livio, Roberto Di Matteo, Demetrio Albertini, Dino Baggio, Diego Fuser, Amedeo Carboni.
Strikers - Pierluigi Casiraghi, Fabrizio Ravanelli, Gianfranco Zola, Alessandro Del Piero, Enrico Chiesa.
